evidence: Matches the 'Wallet' label and modifies wallet logic in 'src/wallet/wallet.cpp' and migration tests.
rationale: Fixes a failure and unhandled std::bad_function_call exception during legacy-to-descriptor migration for legacy wallets containing watch-only transactions. Resolves linked issue #36483 where migrating a legacy wallet without private keys fails due to prematurely checking mapWallet emptiness before transaction commit, which subsequently triggered an empty abort callback.
